request_limit_semantics: one shared SpendGuard::new_with_campaign_request_limit guard, cloned into every session and proxy route; retries count as admissions; request 361 must fail before provider dispatch, including a new session
executable_hash_semantics: Separate SHA-256 values bind the reviewed runner source and selected Codex executable; no caller-supplied hash is trusted
spend_ceiling_semantics: finite explicit ceiling and affirmative acceptance that pre-request reservations can be exceeded before post-request settlement
credential_semantics: separate regular file mode 0600; never in process environment, command arguments, transcript, or evidence artifact
evidence_semantics: separate directory outside checkout mode 0700; preserve failures and private raw wire artifacts
